# uzc_load_balancers (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud load balancers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_load_balancers" "all" {}

output "load_balancer_slugs" {
  value = [for lb in data.uzc_load_balancers.all.load_balancers : lb.slug]
}
```
